llm.summary: The skill's files, scripts, and instructions are consistent with a local 'Karpathy-style' LLM wiki for ingesting papers and maintaining markdown pages; nothing requested or installed is disproportionate to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (build and maintain a persistent LLM wiki for papers) match included artifacts: SKILL.md defines file layout and workflows; scripts search/download arXiv PDFs and save to raw/papers. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or external services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md explicitly tells the agent to read and write files under a repo-style workspace (raw/, wiki/, index.md, log.md) and to perform ingest/query/lint operations that modify many markdown files. This is expected for a wiki skill but grants the agent broad filesystem write scope within the project. Also note a minor inconsistency/phrasing: the doc alternately stresses 'you (user) only read' vs 'LLM writes and maintains' — meaning the agent is intended to perform file writes (not a security bug but important to understand).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction-only with two bundled scripts. The scripts perform HTTPS requests to arXiv and save PDFs locally — appropriate for the stated purpose. There is no remote arbitrary code download or obscure host used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The operations (downloading arXiv PDFs, reading/writing repo files) do not require secrets, so requested access is proportionate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation. The skill writes files within its repo workspace (intended behavior). It does not request system-wide config changes or other skills' credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: ingest papers from arXiv and maintain a local markdown wiki. Before installing/using: 1) Understand the agent will read and write many files (raw/, wiki/, index.md, log.md) — back up any important repo data. 2) The bundled scripts download PDFs from arXiv.org over HTTPS (expected); review the scripts if you will run them, especially if you run them with network access. 3) The shell script contains duplicated/embedded Python code and a trailing odd string (looks like an accidental concatenation/packaging bug) — harmless but review/clean it before executing. 4) If you want tighter security, run the skill in a sandboxed workspace or with restricted network/file permissions so it can only modify the intended directory. 5) No secrets are requested by the skill; if future edits add external endpoints or credential use, re-evaluate before giving access.
